data.title: 木更 · 绷带与月色
data.description: 【木更 · 绷带与月色】凌乱的大床上，木更褪下裙装，白皙修长的大腿上贴着战斗留下的医用敷料。她顺着床单轻轻抬起双腿，眼眸泛着迷离水光，向你伸出颤抖的指尖——「伤口其实一点都不疼……但如果修能亲自帮我换药、温柔地吻一下这里的话，我一定会好得更快。」
data.action: 抬起贴有创可贴的大腿
data.promptProse: Adult Kisara reclines on the sheets with one bandaged thigh raised, extending a hand toward the viewer to ask for help with the dressing. Soft bedside light and blue moonlight meet across the bandage and rumpled sheets.
data.animaCaption: Her raised bandaged thigh faces the viewer as she reaches out for help with the dressing.
